summary: Bang Bon is one of the 50 districts (khet) of Bangkok, Thailand, and its Thai name is written บางบอน. The note describes its location by listing its neighbours clockwise from the north. Those neighbours are four Bangkok districts, two districts of Samut Sakhon Province, and one further Bangkok district.
one_line: Bang Bon is one of the 50 districts of Bangkok, Thailand, bordered by several Bangkok districts and two districts of Samut Sakhon Province.
key_facts: Bang Bon (Thai: บางบอน) is one of the 50 districts (khet) of Bangkok, Thailand.
The Thai name บางบอน is pronounced [bāːŋ bɔ̄ːn].
Bang Bon's neighbours, listed clockwise from north, include Bang Khae, Phasi Charoen, Chom Thong, and Bang Khun Thian districts of Bangkok.
Bang Bon borders Mueang Samut Sakhon District of Samut Sakhon Province.
Bang Bon borders Krathum Baen District of Samut Sakhon Province.
Bang Bon borders Nong Khaem District of Bangkok.
The neighbours are listed clockwise from north, with Bang Khae as the first named.
